title: 51 Swahili Phrases in 11 Minutes | Learn Swahili for Beginners (Coffee Shop & Bakery)
description:
Learn 51 essential Swahili phrases in 11 minutes - the fun, fast way.
#Swahili #LearnSwahili #LanguageLearning

Every phrase follows the same rhythm: hear it in English, hear it in Kiswahili, then say it out loud with the pronunciation guide. Perfect for beginners, travellers and anyone who wants to speak Swahili with confidence.

WHAT YOU GET
- 8 themed chapters, 51 real-life phrases
- Kiswahili audio from a native voice
- English pronunciation guide for every line
- A brand-new lesson every single day

CHAPTERS
0:07  Coffee Shop & Bakery · Duka la Kahawa na Mkate
1:20  Public Transportation · Usafiri wa Umma
2:32  Motivation · Motisha
3:57  Forgiveness · Msamaha
5:07  Mindfulness · Kujitambua
6:30  Joy · Shangwe
8:02  Gratitude · Shukrani
9:24  Making Plans · Kupanga Mipango

PHRASE LIST

COFFEE SHOP & BAKERY · Duka la Kahawa na Mkate
• Hi, what bakes are fresh today? - Habari, ni mkate gani umeoka leo?  [HabARI, ni mKATE gani uMOKA leO?]
• Do you have coffee for two? - Mna kahawa ya watu wawili?  [MnA KAHAWA ya watu waWILI?]
• Can I get oat milk, please? - Naomba maziwa ya uji wa shayiri.  [NaOMBA MAziwa ya uJI wa SHAYIRI.]
• This smell is making me hungry. - Harufu hii inanifanya njaa.  [haRUfu hii inaNiFANIsha NJAA.]
• Which bread is best with butter? - Ni mkate gani unaendana na siagi?  [Ni mKATE gani uNaeNDANA na SIAGI?]
• What pastries are still warm now? - Kuna keki gani bado ziko vuguvugu?  [KuNA KEki gani bado zIko vUguvugu?]

PUBLIC TRANSPORTATION · Usafiri wa Umma
• Is this bus to Kariakoo? - Basi hii inaenda Kariakoo?  [BASI hii INAENDA Kariakoo?]
• What stop is closest to here? - Kituo gani kilicho karibu zaidi hapa?  [KITUO gani KILICHO karibu ZAIDI hapa?]
• Please let me get off first. - Nipe nafasi ni- toroke kwanza.  [NIpe NAFASI ni-TOROKE KWANZA.]
• How much is the fare, please? - uliulizauliuliza nauli ni kiasi gani?  [NAULI ni KIASI gani, tafadhali?]
• I only have small change. - Nina pesa ndogo tu.  [NINA PESA NDOGO TU.]
• Do we pay before we board? - Tunapolipa kabla ya kupanda?  [TUNAPOLIPA KABLA ya KUPANDA?]

MOTIVATION · Motisha
• Today, I choose progress over comfort. - Leo, nachagua maendeleo kuliko faraja.  [LEO, nacheagua MAENDELEO kuliko FARAjA.]
• I can start messy, then improve. - Ninaweza kuanza nikiwa na machafuko, kisha kuboresha.  [NINAWEZA KUANZA nikiwa na machAFUKU, kISHA kuboreSHA.]
• My effort counts, even when quiet. - Jitihada zangu zinahesabiwa, hata zikikaa kimya.  [JITIHADA zangu ziNAHesabiwa, hata zikAKAA KIMYA.]
• I trust the process, not my mood. - Ninamwamini mchakato, si hali yangu.  [NINAMWAMINI MCHAKATO, si HALI yangu.]
• One text, one step, just do it. - Ujumbe mmoja, hatua moja, fanya tu.  [Ujumbe MMOJA, HATUA MOJA, fanya TU.]
• I move forward, even if I’m unsure. - Ninasonga mbele, hata kama si hakika.  [NINASONGA MBELE, hata kama si HAKIKA.]

FORGIVENESS · Msamaha
• Thank you for saying sorry. - Asante kwa kuomba msamaha.  [A-SAN-te kwa U-OM-ba MSA-ha-fa-ha.]
• I’m ready to forgive you. - Niko tayari kuku-samehe.  [NI-ko ta-AY-a-ka KU-ku-SAME-he.]
• Let’s drop it, we’re okay. - Tuweke hayo nyuma, tuko sawa.  [TU-we-ke ha-yo NYU-ma, TU-ko SA-wa.]
• I choose peace over resentment. - Nnachagua amani kuliko chuki.  [NNA-cha-gu-a A-ma-ni ku-li-ko CHU-ki.]
• I forgive you, no more talking. - Nimesamehe, usililie tena.  [NI-me-sa-ME-he, u-si-LI-e TE-na.]
• We can start fresh today. - Leo tunaweza kuanza upya.  [LE-o tu-na-weza KU-an-za u-PYA.]

MINDFULNESS · Kujitambua
• Feel your breath at your nose - Hisi pumzi yako kupitia pua yako sasa  [HISI PUMZI yako kupitIA PUA yako SAASA]
• Let your gaze soften and blink - Punguza kutazama, fumba macho kwa upole sasa  [PUNGUZA KUTAZAMA, FUMBA MAlCHO kwa UPOle SAASA]
• Name one sound without judging it - Taja sauti moja tu, bila kuhukumu  [TAJA SAUTI MOJA TU, BILA KUHUKUMU]
• Notice your hands resting right now - Tambua mikono yako ilivyo tulivu sasa hivi  [TAMBUA MIKONO yako ILIVYO tulivu SAASA hivi]
• Relax your belly like a wave - Lainisha tumbo, lichukue pumzi kwa utulivu  [LAINISHA TUMBO, LIchukUE PUMZI kwa utulivu]
• Watch thoughts pass like clouds - Tazama mawazo yakipita kama mawingu  [TAZAMA MAWAzO yakIPITA kama MAWINGU]

JOY · Shangwe
• This feels like the best night - Usiku huu una ladha ya furaha.  [USIKU huu una LADHA ya FUraha.]
• I’m grinning, even my shoulders feel light - Nacheka, hata mabega yamepungua mzigo.  [NACHEKA, hata MABEGA yamePUNGuwa MZiGO.]
• Let’s dance like nobody’s watching - Tuchangamke, tucheze kama hakuna mtu anayetazama.  [TUCHANGAMKE, TUcheze kama ha kuna MTU anayeTAZAMA.]
• Your text just warmed my whole day - Ujumbe wako umenijia moto siku nzima.  [UJUMBE wako umeNJIa MOTO SIku zima.]
• I needed this laugh, wow - Nilihitaji kicheko hiki, wow.  [NiliHITaji KICHEko hiki, wow.]
